## What's new in 0.4.0

- **A console built around how you present.** **Slides** and **Notes** are two buttons at the left of the current slide's row; their panel comes in from the left, and the same button closes it. **Participants** is back in the top bar and opens as a pop-up (**Pick one** or **Teams**).
- **Two timers, side by side.** The shared timer and My timer are two upright cards that line up row for row. **The time is its own entry**: double-click the minutes or the seconds, type, press **Enter**. While a timer runs, the other parts keep running; **Esc** leaves it as it was. **±** is still there.
- **Teams on the participants' screen**: every name is shown whole, one name per row with a dot and a line between rows. **Clear** takes made teams away; **Shuffle again** makes new ones.
- **Swap the sides**: the **⇄** button in the top bar turns the whole console left to right (and the floating toolbar with it). Presenter remembers it.
- **Everything stays in view**: pop-ups move away from the window edge or open on the other side of their button; the floating toolbar always stays inside its display.
- **One set of tools on the floating toolbar**: the same marks and the same two timer cards as in the console, a **Screens** menu (show another content on Projector 1) and a **Console** button (back to the console).
- **Fix**: in the narrowest console window the **±** button of My timer and the preset times no longer overlap or wrap.

## What's new in 0.3.3

- **Words for any kind of presenting**: "students" are now "participants", the **Class timer** is the **Shared timer**, and class periods are **Sessions**. Your saved settings, lists and sessions stay as they were.
- **Fix**: a video of a slide could stop by itself when you jumped to its slide right after the deck opened.

## What's new in 0.3.2

- **One look for all icons**: the buttons that used coloured emoji (Name picker, Guide, Black screen, window, Whiteboard, warning bells, sessions, save picture, video and sound, the floating toolbar) now have line icons in the text colour, so they follow the light and the dark look.
- The camera button (save the slide as a picture) is centred in its button.

## What's new in 0.3.1

- **Text tool** (**T**): click the slide and type; or drag a box and the text wraps inside it and gets smaller to fit. Click a text to change it, drag it to move it. Eraser and Undo remove a text like any mark. Not on program windows.
- The mark bar shows the tool names only when the pane is wide enough; on a narrow window it shows the icons (the names are in the tooltips).

## What's new in 0.3.0

- **PowerPoint files open on any computer, with their click animations.** Presenter now carries its own LibreOffice, so PPT, PPTX and ODP open without PowerPoint or Keynote. Each page key first shows the next click step of the slide, then turns the page. The slide line shows the steps (for example `1/3 clicks`). Some effects are simpler than in PowerPoint (text that flies in just appears), and fonts or charts can look a little different: check a new deck once before class.
- **Videos and sounds of a PPTX play on the slide**: **▶ Video** next to the slide title, or click the ▶ on the video.
- **My timer From–to**: set sessions by clock time (weekdays, AM/PM); it counts down by itself.
- **Black or white screen**: **B** / **W** (or **.** / **,**). Any key brings the slide back.
- **Screens stay awake** while you project or a timer runs.
- **A deck opens again on the page it showed last** (within 3 hours).
- **Marks stay with their slide** while the deck is open. **📷** saves the slide with its marks as a picture.
- **Zoom tool** (Z): drag a box to enlarge a part of the slide. **Whiteboard**: blank pages to draw on.
- **Type a slide number and press Enter** to jump to it. **Name picker** can make random groups.
- **Larger download**: the Windows zip is about 267 MB because LibreOffice is inside. Mac now has two zips, for Apple silicon and for Intel.

## What's new in 0.2.1

- **Shared timer**: type the time in **Set** (minutes : seconds); the one **Start** starts it.
- **Warning bells**: up to 5 bells, each with its own time and number of beeps. Open them with the **bell** next to the shared timer's name.
- **Change the time**: **±** on either timer adds time to a running timer or takes time away; after the shared timer rang, **+** makes it run again.
- **Open deck** starts in the folder of the deck you opened last.

## What's new in 0.2.0

- **Light or dark look**: ☀ / ☾ in the top bar. The console has a new, rounder design.
- **Shared timer**: set minutes **:** seconds; warning beeps before the end, and once a second in the last 5 seconds.
- **Marks**: a new **Arrow** tool (A). Hold **Shift** for a straight line, a square box, or an arrow in 45° steps. **Ctrl+Z** (⌘Z) and **Esc** work wherever you draw, also on a program window.
- **Text size** moves 5 % a step; hold **A−** or **A+** to go fast.

## Download

Click one file name under **Assets** at the bottom of this page.

| Your computer | Download |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 / 11 | the file ending in **`-win.zip`** |
| Mac with Apple silicon (M1, M2 …), macOS 13 or later | the file ending in **`-mac-arm64.zip`** (Apple menu → **About This Mac** shows **Chip: Apple M…**) |
| Mac with an Intel processor, macOS 13 or later | the file ending in **`-mac-x64.zip`** |

Do not download "Source code". It is for developers only.

## Open

Nothing to install.

**Windows**

1. Right-click the zip → **Extract All**.
2. Open the new folder and double-click **Presenter**.
3. If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC": click **More info → Run anyway**. This is needed once.

**Mac**

1. Double-click the zip. You get **Presenter**.
2. Double-click **Presenter**. If macOS says it cannot check the app: open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down, click **Open Anyway**. This is needed once.
3. PPT and PPTX files open with the LibreOffice inside Presenter. The Mac version of this has not been tried on a real Mac yet: if a PPT does not open, save it as PDF and tell the maintainer.
4. To show program windows (a browser, a video …), allow Presenter in **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen & System Audio Recording**, and, when asked, **Accessibility**.
